intent.proves: No facet reads an analysed index field.
intent.scope: every facet joined to its index field definition

bindings.reason: Measured on 10.30.6 with Truvio.Commerce.MCP 0.6.3: get_index_facets returns each facet's field name and no allowlisted read returns whether an index field is analysed. get_index_facet_fields (not allowlisted) returns systemName, name, group and typeName only. Facets also read fields the index builder generates (ParentGroupIDs) that the repository .index file does not declare, so the Files/System/Repositories XML cannot resolve every facet field either. Needs a handler that joins each facet's field to the index schema's Analyzed flag, generated fields included, and reports analysed ones as offenders over the facets scanned.

sources.ref: A 10.30.6 host with a headless product repository, read-only, 2026-11-13: get_index_facets 7 facet groups; get_index_facet_fields Headless/Products 266 fields with keys systemName, name, group, typeName; Headless/Products.facets reads ParentGroupIDs, which Headless/Products.index does not declare.
